risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (329.6) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, and earnings binary event in 13 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers pattern with supertrend/hull confirmation and extreme fear (VIX crisis) creates contrarian buy setup at support (69.12), offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro panic reverses.
